items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then the next one is a duet, you and Ted Dunbar, In Tandem. ... That was actually – that wasn’t intended to be a record. That was a concert we did at Rutgers.

ctx.x: Other than you and Larry, were there any other jazz instructors?
Yeah. It was me, Larry, Ted Dunbar.
Oh. So he was already there.
